summary: User developed an online relationship with a woman who moved communication to Telegram and introduced an alleged insider trading opportunity then guided the user to deposit about 2000 dollars in USDT into a fake trading platform before a 30.12 percent tax was demanded for withdrawal
user_mistake: trusted an online romantic contact and deposited funds into the trading platform she introduced
prevention: Verify any broker and trading domain independently with the relevant regulator before depositing / Refuse tax payments requested through Telegram or a QR code to unlock withdrawals
